sources.games: 726 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 46.3%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py mars.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 129 (Spear of Mars, God's Rebuke, Bulwark, Arena of Blood), 7.41f.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-20: no Spirit Vessel for offlaners against heavy healing (a support's item); Linken's Sphere for Queen of Pain, Puck, Void Spirit and Storm Spirit against Phantom Assassin and Spirit Breaker, not Slark; Axe levels Battle Hunger second; Templar Assassin keeps Meld > Psi Blades > Refraction.

rules.name: Black King Bar
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Black King Bar: Avatar applies a basic dispel, 60% magic resistance and makes negative effects of enemy spells do nothing for 9/8/7 s. It is in his build (57% of the won games, ~27 min); Pipe of Insight is not.

reason.en: {enemy} and other magic damage heroes are in their team: {item} is in your build, take it earlier, so their spells cannot stop you inside your Arena
reason.uk: {enemy} та інші герої з магічною шкодою: {item} і так у вашій збірці — візьміть його раніше, щоб усередині вашої Arena їхні здібності вас не зупинили

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: bracer 89% (2), magic_wand 64% (5), soul_ring 93% (7), phase_boots 99% (8), cyclone 39% (17), desolator 27% (18), buckler 21% (20), aghanims_shard 82% (21), great_famango 20% (22), black_king_bar 57% (27), sheepstick 20% (38).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 75.0%+: 30:00 18500 (37 games, 75.7%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then lead the fights and take objectives with your team
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім ведіть бійки й беріть об'єкти разом із командою
